purpose: Calculation audit of the same five captured dairy records; not manufacturer validation or a new scoring method.

sourcePolicy.sourceEditionStatus: No manufacturer label publication date or package edition is supplied by these captures. Provider revision/retrieval dates are recorded separately and do not establish a label edition.

sharedLayerFindings.source: All five canonical and serving nutrient sets agree to their recorded rounding. They remain unverified provider observations; internal consistency does not establish source accuracy.
sharedLayerFindings.normalization: The old normalizer labeled canonical OFF _100g observations as mass despite explicit mL serving/package dimensions. The incoming patch uses the supported OFF canonical-field semantics (100 g or 100 mL), binds these consistent volume declarations to 100 mL, and keeps the entered basis and raw fields. No density is assumed and no nutrient quantity is changed.
sharedLayerFindings.categorySelection: resolveBarcodeCategory returns no explicit category for all five. The existing barcodeNutritionAssessment volumeOnly fallback chooses beverage when no mass dataset remains, except nuts/oils. Thus corrected dimensions expose the pre-existing beverage rule; no new milk category was introduced.
sharedLayerFindings.panelSelection: The rank prefers the intact complete explicit reference panel off-100g. It does not mix nutrients from serving, entered, or reference panels.
sharedLayerFindings.scoringPolicyIssueForReview: The beverage energy ramp spans 0 to 60 kcal per 100 mL, and the sugar component takes the larger added-sugar or total-sugar burden (each 0 to 10 g per 100 mL). Naturally occurring total sugars can therefore dominate with zero added sugars. Protein credit is at most two points and is reduced by the limiting burden. These are existing policy choices, not evidence that milk has the reported nutritional quality.
sharedLayerFindings.implementationConclusion: No additional shared implementation error is demonstrated by these five calculations. Do not substitute guessed label values, relabel reference values as serving values, change formula weights, or invent a milk-specific exception.

currentEquation.fiberCredit: 8*clamp(fiber_g_per100mL/5.6); missing fiber earns no credit and remains unknown
currentEquation.thresholdsAre: Existing Trace Nutrition v2 policy; unchanged by this audit.
